name: Great-Great Uncle Charles' Ginger Cookies
author: Great-Great Uncle Charles
steps: In a large bowl, mix together the eggs, oil, molasses, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, combine flour (2+ heaping cups), ginger, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until combined.
[optional] Add a small drizzle of water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Scoop dough onto a baking sheet.
